decision: On a common subset of the same frozen member first-breakout opportunities, does crossing the original leader's traded value add more useful account outcomes than crossing a pre-matched outside-group stock?
objective: Continue empirical small-loss/large-win research without annual30, per-trade30, average-win, win-rate, payoff or holding-duration acceptance hurdles. No stable-return certification from repeatedly inspected development history.

source.inheritance: Bind all six unchanged raw caches and batch43 passing plan/input-completion/input-validation/validation/delivery. Inherit every original formation and original Top5 opportunity, including unknowns; do not rebuild parent lock, peer group, first-breakout clock, owner or rank. No2026 source, new universe or industry metadata.
source.limitations: Fixed surviving local cohorts, raw prices and incomplete historical status/coverage remain. Board-local statistical peers are not verified industry/theme memberships or market-wide leadership.

validity.calendar: Exact ordered unique supplied source slots, including warmup; no compressed missing history. Numeric reads stop at registered end.
validity.bar: Frozen research_leader_lag._Series raw OHLCV/envelope/known-status validity. Explicit finite positive CNY amounts additionally required. No individual-stock repair or new liquidity/listing/ST/Q filter.
validity.amount3: M3(s,d)=math.fsum of exact d-2..d positive amounts, only when all three required price/status bars and amounts are valid. Unknown stays unknown.
validity.mean20: math.fsum(amount[A-20:A])/20 over exact A-20..A-1 slots, excluding A. All20 raw price/status bars and amounts must be valid, and sum/mean finite positive.

matching.scope: For every parent formation with status formed, including those producing no future Top5 opportunity, match exactly once at A. Retain all parent locked/not-formed events as inherited dispositions without matching.
matching.identity: One pseudo anchor per parentEventId=(A,originalAnchor); all frozen members share it. Different formations may reuse a pseudo anchor.
matching.pool: All securities in the same frozen board cohort except the original anchor and all20 frozen members. No A-day amount/status, future availability, future return, original member eligibility, theme or leadership rank participates in matching.
matching.scale: Both original anchor and candidate require known mean20. If original scale is unknown, match status anchorScaleUnknown. Otherwise eligible candidates require known mean20. No valid candidate means noEligibleCandidate.
matching.distance: abs(math.log(candidateMean20)-math.log(anchorMean20)); select smallest exact unrounded float distance, then lexicographically smallest symbol for a tie. No caliper, tolerance, parameter search, random seed or replacement.
matching.freeze: Selected identity never changes because its A-day M3, a member's initial relation, T evidence or future outcomes are unfavorable or unknown. No second-nearest fallback. A-day data are assessed only after identity is frozen.
matching.interpretation: The selected stock is outside this specific frozen group, not proven unrelated, random or non-leading. The matching controls only prior traded-value scale; strength, theme, correlation, news and A-day activity are not balanced.

commonSupport.population: Every original batch43 Top5 opportunity retains original A,T,member,anchor,owner and originalRank. The parent already required member M3(A)<=real M3(A); adding the pseudo condition defines a NEW common subset. Do not call this the identical old43 control population.
commonSupport.evidence: Recompute and retain member, real and pseudo M3 at A,T-1,T from raw bars. Store all individually knowable values and reason flags even when another requirement fails. Bind recomputed inherited member/real values to parent evidence.
commonSupport.priority: Exclusive status order: matchUnavailable; initialUnknown if any A M3 unknown; initialAbove if known member M3(A)>either anchor M3(A); decisionUnknown if any T-1/T M3 unknown; commonKnown otherwise. Keep independent unknown and failed-initial reason flags in addition to exclusive status. No backfill.
commonSupport.initial: Known member M3(A)<=real M3(A) AND member M3(A)<=pseudo M3(A), equality admitted. Above or unknown removes the opportunity from ALL three policies, with its original slot retained in the denominator.
commonSupport.clock: T is the parent's first price breakout in A+1..A+5. Amount failure/unknown does not wait for a later breakout or extend the episode; original Top5 precedes all new masks.
commonSupport.control: Admit every commonKnown original opportunity, without any crossing condition.
commonSupport.realCross: Within commonKnown, member M3(T-1)<=real M3(T-1) AND member M3(T)>real M3(T).
commonSupport.pseudoCross: Within commonKnown, member M3(T-1)<=pseudo M3(T-1) AND member M3(T)>pseudo M3(T).
commonSupport.signals: Exactly signalId,strategyId,symbol,signalDate,originalRank. New identity leaderMatchedAnchorV1:A:realAnchor:member; retain parentOpportunityId for reconciliation. Same identity across policies; T-close decision and unchanged next-source-open execution.

readout.primary: All12 realCross-minus-pseudoCross comparisons across2 periods,3 boards,2 exits. No winning-cohort selection.
readout.secondary: All12 realCross-minus-control and12 pseudoCross-minus-control comparisons; all36 accounts. Separately12 old43-control versus new-common-control context rows, labelled population/selection change rather than anchor effect.
readout.coverage: All parent formation dispositions; match-known/unknown counts; matching distance distributions and pseudo reuse; original Top5 through each exclusive common-support status; all three schedules, rejected/unfilled/closed/open dispositions. Keep four overlap cells both/realOnly/pseudoOnly/neither within commonKnown.
readout.diagnostics: Prior20 scale ratios/distances, A-day pseudo/real M3 ratio and member-to-both ratios, distinct pseudo counts and repeated usage are descriptive only. Do not derive new gates from diagnostics.
readout.performance: Full net return/drawdown/exposure/costs, closed win/loss means and medians, expectancy/payoff/PF, loss streaks/tails/profit concentration, open realized/unrealized PnL and valuation flags. Missing or undefined ratios remain null.
readout.time: All annual, half-year, existing narrative-phase and9.24 continuous-equity intervals; no capital reset, date-coded switch or annualization of unequal before/after intervals.

validation.freeze: Protocol, matching, code and source hashes before any new actual candidate coverage or schedules. Complete all six preparations and independent reconstruction before accounts. Preserve failures without changing selection based on results.
validation.synthetic: Historical20 exact slots/excludesA, log-distance and symbol ties, excluded peer group, missing scale/no candidate, A-unknown/initialAbove and no fallback, matching all formed events including no future opportunity, pseudo reuse, immutable identities/rank/no refill, four crossing cells, common status priority/independent flags, unknown required bars, no source mutation and future perturbation invariance.
validation.independent: Inherit exact hash-bound parent formation/Top5 proof; separately reconstruct candidate matching from raw histories and all new common-support values/masks, audit36 fee/cash/holdings/risk paths without executing duplicate trials, independently rebuild all readout tables.
validation.interpretation: This is a conditional strategy comparison, not randomized identification of leadership or investors. A positive result can justify further preregistered validation; repeated development history cannot establish stable returns.
